verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents offline evaluations on curated datasets during development to compare versions and catch regressions. It also documents running the app on a dataset as an experiment with configurable repetitions, concurrency and caching, and offers code-rule and LLM-as-judge evaluators. That covers the eval-execution half of the story, but nothing in the pack shows running these in CI or failing a build or deployment on results. missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g., test-runner or CI pipeline support), pass/fail thresholds or assertions that gate deployments, hands-on corroboration of CI gating.
